entities.summary: Jonathan Mychal Gibson is an American professional basketball player for the Al-Ula of the Saudi Basketball League. He played college basketball for New Mexico State before playing professionally in Turkey, Israel, Italy, China and Iran. He made a name for himself in China, earning the league's scoring title in both the 2013–14 and the 2015–16 season, with 32.5 and 42 points per game respectively.
